LOOPIFY — SAMPLE CREDITS
Prepared 2026-10-24

GRAND PIANO
Salamander Grand Piano v3 by Alexander Holm.
Source: https://github.com/sfzinstruments/SalamanderGrandPiano
Original recording: https://archive.org/details/SalamanderGrandPianoV3
Repository version: 3382bf9496bba2486f5ab0de55a264d1dfc38404
License: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported (CC BY 3.0)
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
Full legal code: samples/licenses/Salamander-LICENSE.txt
Repository FLAC conversion and SFZ remapping by kinwie. Only the audio samples
are used here; no SFZ instrument mapping is used.

FM PIANO / MARIMBA / VIBRAPHONE
Versilian Community Sample Library (VCSL), Versilian Studios LLC and contributors.
Source: https://github.com/sgossner/VCSL
Repository version: c1ea7bcc3c7309650ab0da9d15c9cd1fbc4a4c7e
License: CC0 1.0 Universal
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Full legal code: samples/licenses/VCSL-LICENSE.txt
FM Piano: original user-created TX81Z patches sampled from hardware using Samplit.
Marimba: medium velocity, Outrigger microphone position.
Vibraphone: soft mallets, velocity 2, first round robin, Main microphone position.

MODIFICATIONS FOR LOOPIFY
Selected a single recorded velocity layer per instrument (Salamander layer 8,
FM Piano layer 2, medium Marimba, soft-mallet Vibraphone layer 2).
Selected root notes for a compact multisample bank. Unrecorded notes are played
by resampling the closest available recording in the application.
Converted original FLAC/WAV to stereo 44.1 kHz 160 kbps MP3.
Retained at most 12 seconds per piano recording, 10 seconds for FM Piano and
Vibraphone, and 8 seconds for Marimba. Applied a 100 ms fade at the end.
Applied fixed gain across each instrument's recordings to reduce level
differences: Grand Piano 1x, FM Piano 2x, Marimba 16x, Vibraphone 0.8x.
Mallet source note names were shifted up one octave in the application mapping,
based on measured pitch, to match scientific notation (C4 = MIDI note 60).
This is a compact edited selection; it does not reproduce the complete source
instruments, velocity layers, pedal/resonance samples, or round robins.
No endorsement by any original sample creator is implied.

Every original sample URL, original and output SHA-256 checksum, output size,
duration, and measured pitch are listed in samples/SOURCES.json.
Please preserve these credits when redistributing the included Salamander samples.
